notes.title: 100% Free to play (soon)
notes.notes:
These past 8 years LuGus Studios has evolved a lot, from a startup company exclusively building work-for hire games, to a thriving and diverse studios with its own strong IP’s like [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/410340/Liftoff_FPV_Drone_Racing/]Liftoff: FPV Drone Racing[/url]. Yet the creation of the library of LuGus Studios all started exactly 5 years ago with our first self-published game “Runes of Brennos”. Although the game is showing its age, we are proud it has been enjoyed by over 17.000 people these past few years. We are happy to invite more players to experience our first self-published game.

To celebrate this anniversary and a very successful 2019 for the company, Runes of Brennos will be made completely free on Steam later this month! 
£
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7428496/599925759955de64701ea082407ef9ae40c3866d.png[/img]

Runes of Brennos is a small casual game released in 2015. In the game you take control of a mighty druid seeking to seize power. Draw magical runes on the screen and see their power vanquish your opponents. Memorize and harness combos as you develop your skills. Understand the strengths and weaknesses of the runes to unleash their full potential. The road to power is a dangerous one, but with the right combination of strategy and skill the throne could be yours!

notes.title: Version 1.1 released.
notes.notes:
Runes of Brennos 1.1 Change list:
- Certain rune combinations (e.g. water-wind) now properly block one another where they failed to do so before in certain situations.
- AI enemy now properly uses runes that it failed to use before.
- Selected arena now resets upon re-entering the campaign map window.
- Minor bugfixes
